name: Industrial Techno
description: Distorted rumbling kicks, saturated dense mids, harsh metallic percussion, relentless and loud.
notes: Distorted kick + rumble 30-100 Hz, saturation fills the mids.
Harsher 2-5 kHz than regular techno (metallic hits, noise).
Loud: around -7 LUFS; mono below 130 Hz.
source: hand-tuned estimate from genre conventions (not measured from a track corpus)
